thresholds.units: Q=v*q/gamma; divide by v/gamma to obtain inverse Angstrom

initial_count_hypothesis.scope: Our provisional whole-domain hypothesis, not a published global node-count assertion.

limits: No non-Abelian frame-charge transport or Euler-class computation in this benchmark.
No self-consistent Hartree-Fock, global Brillouin-zone gap certificate, or experimental prediction.
Finite searches can miss nodes; counts refer to the specified search domain.
This projected model is not the v067 single-valley continuum model.
